statement: Linux and SDL define input 0x43 battery status: kernel requires 15 bytes total, ID at offset0, state u8@1, level u8@2, voltage u16 LE@3, system voltage@5, input voltage@7, battery current@9, input current@11, temperature@13 (all u16 LE). Kernel maps state codes 1=discharging, 2=charging, 4=charged; the SDL enum also declares intermediate state codes. Wired kernel registers an Ibex battery device, but no physical wired 0x43 cadence or values are available. Kernel:337-365,2499-2528,2590-2604; SDL:351-373,682-697.

applicability.revision: host consumers at Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0; physical revision not measured
applicability.scope: Wired USB 28de:1302; host-side source parsing / host commands only, no live or physical validation. Refer to docs/steam-controller-2026-research-gaps.md C6 section.
